summary: Launch day: benchmark report landing page PDF download link returning 404 (cached old asset path)
description:
Issue summary:
During the benchmark report launch window, the "Download the full report (PDF)" button on the public landing page intermittently returned 404. The landing page HTML was being served from CDN cache with an outdated asset path.

Customer impact:
- Customer-facing / public web issue.
- Users clicking the PDF CTA saw a 404 page.
- Primary impact is reduced report downloads + degraded launch experience.

Start time (approx): 2025-02-25 10:06 PT
End time (approx): 2025-02-25 10:43 PT
Duration: ~37 minutes

Where observed:
- Landing page: https://redwoodinference.com/benchmarks/latency-per-dollar (canonical)
- Download button linked to an old path: /downloads/Redwood_Latency_Per_Dollar_Report.pdf
- Actual asset path in current deploy: /assets/reports/redwood-latency-per-dollar-2025-02.pdf

Symptoms:
- Clicking the download CTA returns 404 from CDN.
- Directly accessing the new asset path succeeded.
- Some users reported success after hard refresh, suggesting cache variance.

Suspected root cause:
Docs/marketing site deploy changed the PDF asset location/filename late in the release process, but CloudFront/edge cache continued serving the previous HTML (or previous redirect rules) for a subset of POPs.

Immediate remediation plan:
1) Add server-side redirect from old /downloads/... path to the new asset path (301).
2) Purge/invalidate CDN for the landing page path + old download path.
3) Confirm via external checks (incognito + multiple regions) and ask Marketing war-room to re-test.

Follow-ups:
- Add pre-launch smoke test for all CTAs on launch landing pages.
- Add synthetic monitoring for top CTAs (download link 200 + expected content-type).

Slack comms:
Coordinated in #marketing launch war-room and #docs for verification / status updates.
